nodes.label: Evidence-First Architecture Constraint
nodes.rationale: Deterministic code owns stable identifiers, validation, hierarchy, and export policy while models can only propose typed evidence.

nodes.label: Local OCR Evidence Ownership
nodes.rationale: The selected local OCR engine owns layout, element IDs, normalized boxes, types, confidence, and reading order; Luna may only replace qualifying text on existing elements.

nodes.label: Trusted Local Workstation Boundary
nodes.rationale: The application is intended for a trusted local workstation without multi-user authentication or tenant isolation; service ports must remain loopback-only.

nodes.label: Bounded Luna Egress
nodes.rationale: Each optional Luna feature has a defined and limited category of document data that may be sent remotely.

nodes.label: Context Crop Experiment
nodes.rationale: The larger-context crop option was removed because targeted A/B evaluation failed hallucination and call-count promotion gates despite increased anchor coverage.

nodes.label: Parse-Then-Reason Design
nodes.rationale: A local visual parser establishes evidence before optional reasoning stages act on bounded grounded context.

nodes.label: Recovery Ownership Contract
nodes.rationale: Luna additions and changes to geometry, type, structure, or reading order are ignored so local OCR remains the authority for grounded document structure.

nodes.label: Azure Bulk Medical Fax Production Baseline
nodes.norm_label: azure bulk medical fax production baseline

nodes.label: PHI Retention and Deletion Controls
nodes.rationale: Medical-fax inputs and outputs have explicit time-limited retention and deletion requirements to reduce PHI exposure.

nodes.label: Review Before Extracting
nodes.rationale: Users must verify source coverage and difficult regions before trusting field extraction because extraction cannot safely supply absent or unreadable information.

nodes.label: ADE Workstation Classification
nodes.rationale: The project is classified primarily as an ADE-pattern workstation because it uses grounded parse-then-reason roles but lacks enterprise IDP connectors, queues, systems-of-record write-back, and worker fleets.

nodes.label: Product Taxonomy Risk
nodes.rationale: Calling the product enterprise IDP or LandingAI ADE would overstate its scope or imply an integration that does not exist.

nodes.label: Separated Text, Layout, and Table Metrics
nodes.norm_label: separated text, layout, and table metrics

nodes.label: Finite Validation and Repair
nodes.rationale: Finite repair attempts prevent repeated prompting from converting unsupported output into a plausible-looking result.

nodes.label: Layout-Aware Workflow for Extracting Large Field Sets
nodes.norm_label: layout-aware workflow for extracting large field sets

nodes.label: Source and Field-Specification Separation
nodes.rationale: The source document is evidence, while the field specification is an instruction set and must not be treated as evidence.

nodes.label: Parse-Then-Reason Design
nodes.rationale: A local visual parser establishes evidence geometry before optional model calls operate on selected crops or compact structured context.

nodes.label: Evaluation Corpus Manifest Query Rationale
nodes.rationale: load_corpus_manifest() is described as the boundary adapter that converts declarative corpus artifacts into typed corpus models before benchmark metrics run.

nodes.label: Evaluation Corpus Manifest
nodes.rationale: The query connects manifest-v1.schema.json, corpus models, local sources and annotations, and live evaluation reporting.

nodes.norm_label: pdf, png, jpg, and tif inputs

nodes.label: Luna Recovery Restrictions
nodes.rationale: Luna recovery is limited to high-confidence text-only corrections so GLM element identity, geometry, reading order, and parsing authority remain intact.

nodes.label: Local OCR Geometry Ownership
nodes.rationale: Geometry is always local-OCR-owned, while grounding targets base Markdown rather than presentation refinement.

nodes.label: Agentic Failure Isolation
nodes.rationale: Agentic feature failures and missing OpenAI credentials must not invalidate a local parse.
